Czech Extraliga (ELH) shot attempts

Source: R/elh.R
elh_shots.Rd

Shot attempts of one game with rink coordinates and result code (visualization/shots/{match_id}.json).

Ids are hokej.cz ids (hokejcz_player_id, hokejcz_team_id), not the onlajny ids of elh_pbp(). The provider's match_shot_resutl_id (sic) is kept and aliased shot_result_id: 4 = goal (is_goal, verified against the play-by-play); 1/2/3/5 are unknown. time is seconds from the start of the game, EXCEPT in 2016-17, where it is only the period's start offset (0/1200/2400; use real_date). period is derived from time and holds in both eras. The faceoff win percentage block of the file is left out (return_parsed = FALSE keeps it).

Usage

elh_shots(match_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

match_id

hokej.cz game id (the S3 file name; hokejcz_game_id of elh_game_ids() / elh_scoreboard()), e.g. 2928321. Not the onlajny game id.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE). Pass FALSE for the raw JSON as a list.

Value

A tibble (return_parsed = TRUE; zero rows for a malformed body), else the raw JSON list:

col_nametypedescription
hokejcz_game_idintegerhokej.cz game id (the S3 file name; shots match.id, scoreboard hokejcz_id). integer.
game_datecharacterGame date (shots: YYYY-MM-DD string; scoreboard: Date).
hokejcz_home_team_idintegerhokej.cz team id of the home team (Sparta = 8); NOT the onlajny id of the play-by-play.
home_team_namecharacterHome team full name.
home_team_codecharacterHome team code, e.g. SPA.
hokejcz_away_team_idintegerhokej.cz team id of the away team (Vitkovice = 7); NOT the onlajny id of the play-by-play.
away_team_namecharacterAway team full name.
away_team_codecharacterAway team code, e.g. VIT.
shot_idintegerFeed id of the shot event.
hokejcz_player_idintegerhokej.cz player id of the shooter (Hradec = 10093378); NOT an onlajny id. No player crosswalk is published.
jerseyintegerShooter's jersey number (the join key for a per-game crosswalk with the play-by-play names).
first_namecharacterShooter's given name.
last_namecharacterShooter's family name.
hokejcz_team_idintegerhokej.cz team id of the shooting team (equals the home or away team id).
team_sidecharacterThe team's side: home or away.
match_shot_resutl_idintegerShot result code, provider's typo kept: 4 = goal (verified against the play-by-play); 1/2/3/5 unknown.
shot_result_idintegerAlias of match_shot_resutl_id: 4 = goal; 1/2/3/5 unknown.
is_goallogicalTrue when the result code is 4 (goal).
timeintegerSeconds from the start of the game; in 2016-17 only the period's start offset (0 / 1200 / 2400), use real_date.
periodintegerPeriod number derived from the game clock (20-minute periods; 4 = overtime); null on a clockless entry.
coordinate_xnumericShot position along the rink LENGTH (goal to goal), centred at 0, normalised so the home team shoots at +x and the away team at -x; about -100..100. The scaling (units) and the orientation are inferred from the data, not documented by the provider.
coordinate_ynumericShot position across the rink WIDTH (board to board), centred at 0; about -100..100. The scaling (each axis looks independently scaled to -100..100) and which board is positive are inferred from the data, not documented by the provider.
real_datecharacterWall-clock time of the shot, local YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

Details

Coordinate caveat (unverified). coordinate_x runs along the rink LENGTH (goal to goal), centred at 0 and normalised so the home team shoots at +x and the away team at -x; coordinate_y runs across the WIDTH; both are about -100..100. That scaling and orientation are inferred from the data: the provider documents neither, and they have not been verified against a rink diagram or an independent source. Treat the coordinates as relative positions, not rink feet, until verified.

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: a missing file (404) or a file without shots. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: an error envelope, a body for another game, an empty or non-JSON 200, or any other non-2xx. fastRhockey_bad_request: HTTP 400/422 or a bad match_id.

See also

Other ELH Functions: elh_events(), elh_game_ids(), elh_list_objects(), elh_pbp(), elh_pbp_goals(), elh_pbp_latest(), elh_pbp_mobile(), elh_scoreboard()
